name: hello
description: Toolchain and framework proof: a blob in free flash with no hooks at all. Applying it changes 0 instructions of stock code, so the ECU behaves exactly as before - but it is still an EXAMPLE and must not be flashed.
ram_status_note: 0x7FFB00 is the block re/findings/ram.md section 8.1 recommends (C2, issue #23: VERIFIED-STATIC that nothing references it, dynamic confirmation pending). Used here only so the template shows the right address; nothing reads or writes it on an ECU because this patch is never hooked in. (Until 2026-09-16 the example used 0x806000, which C2 showed to be inside the KWP programming copy.)

changes.why: hello code and constants (88 B of free flash)
